title: 2026 UK CBAM carbon pricing verification form QA controls

sources.title: Get a carbon pricing verification form
Claiming Carbon Price Relief for CBAM

facts.source_fact: A completed carbon pricing verification form is required to support a Carbon Price Relief claim.
facts.expected_handling: Require form before relief evidence is accepted.

facts.source_fact: The importer can obtain the form from the installation or supply chain.
The form must be completed by an independent verifier meeting the required standards.
Relief cannot be claimed without the form or with an inappropriate verifier.
The form is tied to an installation that manufactured or processed the CBAM good.
A verification form is needed for each CBAM good for which relief is claimed.
facts.expected_handling: Do not reuse one form across unsupported goods.

facts.source_fact: The form identifies elements of the qualifying carbon pricing scheme affecting installation emissions.
Thresholds, free allowances and compensation may be relevant depending on the scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Do not assume every component applies.

facts.source_fact: Compensation is handled separately from summing priced-emission components.
The verification form supports tax relief and is not itself a parcel emissions measurement.
